det [[1, w², w²], [w², 1, w], [w², w, 1]], where w is a cube root of 1, equals —
questions.work:
Expand: 1(1 − w²) − w²(w² − w³) + w²(w³ − w²).
With w³ = 1: 1 − w² − w²(w² − 1) + w²(1 − w²) = 1 − w² − w⁴ + w² + w² − w⁴ = 1 + w² − 2w (w⁴ = w).
= (1 + w + w²) − 3w = −3w.

sections.title: Objective type questions of four 1-mark parts.

questions.q: True or False: (a) Matrix A is singular if |A| ≠ 0. (b) |a+b c+d; e+f g+h| = |a c; e g| + |b d; f h|. (c) Interchanging two rows changes the sign of a determinant. (d) The determinant of a 3 × 3 skew-symmetric matrix is 0.
questions.answer:
(a) False — singular means |A| = 0.
(b) False — a determinant splits along one row (or column) at a time only.
(c) True.
(d) True — |A| = |A'| = |−A| = −|A| ⇒ |A| = 0.

questions.q: Without expanding, prove that |0 a −b; −a 0 −c; b c 0| = 0.
questions.answer:
Let Δ be the determinant. Its transpose has every element negated (it is skew-symmetric), so Δ = |A'| = |−A| = (−1)³Δ = −Δ.
Hence 2Δ = 0 ⇒ Δ = 0.

questions.q: Show that |1 a bc; 1 b ca; 1 c ab| = (a − b)(b − c)(c − a).
questions.answer:
R₁ → R₁ − R₂, R₂ → R₂ − R₃:
|0 a−b c(b−a); 0 b−c a(c−b); 1 c ab| = (a − b)(b − c)|0 1 −c; 0 1 −a; 1 c ab|.
Expand along C₁: 1 × (1·(−a) − (−c)·1) = c − a.
So Δ = (a − b)(b − c)(c − a).

questions.q: If A = [[sin x, 1, 1], [1, eˣ, 1], [cos x, 0, 1]], show that |4A| = 64|A|.
questions.answer: Each of the 3 rows has the factor 4 taken out: |4A| = 4³|A| = 64|A|.

questions.q: Prove that |−a² ab ac; ab −b² bc; ac bc −c²| = 4a²b²c².
questions.answer:
Take a, b, c from R₁, R₂, R₃ and a, b, c from C₁, C₂, C₃: Δ = a²b²c² |−1 1 1; 1 −1 1; 1 1 −1|.
= a²b²c² [−1(1 − 1) − 1(−1 − 1) + 1(1 + 1)] = a²b²c²(0 + 2 + 2) = 4a²b²c².
Expand along R₁: −1 × (x·x − x·1) = −(x² − x) = 0 ⇒ x(x − 1) = 0 ⇒ x = 0 or 1.

questions.q: Using determinants, check whether (a, b + c), (b, c + a) and (c, a + b) form a triangle.
questions.answer:
Δ = |a b+c 1; b c+a 1; c a+b 1|. C₁ → C₁ + C₂: every entry of C₁ becomes a + b + c.
Δ = (a + b + c)|1 b+c 1; 1 c+a 1; 1 a+b 1| = 0 (C₁ = C₃).
The area is 0, so the points are collinear and do not form a triangle.

or.answer:
C₁ → C₁ + C₂ + C₃: C₁ becomes 5x + 4 in every row. Take it out.
R₂ → R₂ − R₁, R₃ → R₃ − R₁: |1 2x 2x; 0 4−x 0; 0 0 4−x|.
Δ = (5x + 4)(4 − x)².

questions.q: Using properties of determinants, prove |a−b−c 2a 2a; 2b b−c−a 2b; 2c 2c c−a−b| = (a + b + c)³.
questions.answer:
R₁ → R₁ + R₂ + R₃: R₁ becomes (a + b + c, a + b + c, a + b + c). Take (a + b + c) out:
Δ = (a + b + c)|1 1 1; 2b b−c−a 2b; 2c 2c c−a−b|.
C₂ → C₂ − C₁, C₃ → C₃ − C₁: |1 0 0; 2b −(a+b+c) 0; 2c 0 −(a+b+c)|.
Expand along R₁: (a + b + c) × (a + b + c)² = (a + b + c)³.
